description:
Create a new Geospatial Primitives benchmark to test cross-platform spatial SQL
functions. This benchmark covers ST_* functions, GEOGRAPHY/GEOMETRY types, and
spatial operations that are increasingly important for location-based analytics.

This differs from the specialized-geospatial TODO (PostGIS integration) by:
- Focusing on OLAP platforms with native geospatial support (Snowflake, BigQuery, DuckDB)
- Testing SQL-level primitives, not a new adapter
- Using synthetic/generated geospatial data, not requiring PostGIS

Use cases covered:
- Distance calculations (point-to-point, point-to-polygon)
- Spatial predicates (contains, intersects, within)
- Geometry transformations (buffer, simplify, union)
- Spatial aggregations (convex hull, clustering)
- Geospatial joins

anti_patterns.dont: add DuckDB-specific extension loading to BaseBenchmark
anti_patterns.instead: handle spatial extension loading in the DuckDB platform adapter

preserves.behavior: Existing spatial query support in NYC Taxi benchmark unaffected

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.core.geo_primitives import GeoPrimitivesBenchmark; print('OK')"

- geo_contains_point: Point within polygon
- geo_intersects_polygons: Polygon overlap
- geo_within_region: Points within region polygon
- geo_covers_area: Polygon covers another
- geo_touches_boundary: Geometries touch
- geo_disjoint_check: Geometries don't intersect

Example (Snowflake):
```sql
SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    n.n_name
FROM customer_geo c
JOIN nation_geo n
    ON ST_CONTAINS(n.nation_polygon, c.customer_location)
LIMIT 100;
```

- geo_buffer_point: Create buffer around point
- geo_simplify_polygon: Simplify complex polygon
- geo_centroid: Calculate centroid
- geo_envelope: Bounding box
- geo_convexhull: Convex hull of points

Example (Snowflake):
```sql
SELECT
    n_nationkey,
    ST_CENTROID(nation_polygon) as nation_center,
    ST_AREA(nation_polygon) / 1e6 as area_sq_km
FROM nation_geo;
```

- geo_union_regions: Union of multiple polygons
- geo_collect_points: Collect points into multipoint
- geo_convexhull_customers: Convex hull of customer locations
- geo_extent_suppliers: Bounding box of all suppliers

Example (BigQuery):
```sql
SELECT
    c_mktsegment,
    ST_UNION_AGG(customer_location) as segment_coverage,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count
FROM customer_geo
GROUP BY c_mktsegment;
```

- geo_area_nation: Area of nation polygons
- geo_length_route: Length of shipping route
- geo_perimeter_region: Perimeter of region
- geo_area_buffer: Area of buffered point

- geo_h3_index: Convert point to H3 cell
- geo_h3_boundary: Get H3 cell boundary
- geo_h3_neighbors: Get neighboring cells
- geo_h3_aggregation: Aggregate by H3 cell

Note: H3 has broader support (including ClickHouse)

Example (Snowflake):
```sql
SELECT
    c_custkey,
    H3_LATLNG_TO_CELL(ST_Y(customer_location), ST_X(customer_location), 7) as h3_cell
FROM customer_geo
LIMIT 100;
```

Example (Snowflake):
```sql
SELECT
    c_custkey,
    ST_POINT(-122.4194, 37.7749) as sf_location,
    ST_X(customer_location) as cust_lng,
    ST_Y(customer_location) as cust_lat
FROM customer_geo
LIMIT 100;
```

- geo_distance_points: Distance between two points
- geo_distance_point_polygon: Distance to polygon boundary
- geo_dwithin_radius: Points within radius
- geo_nearest_neighbor: Find N nearest points
- geo_distance_matrix: Pairwise distances (small set)
- geo_shipping_distance: Distance between supplier and customer

Example (Snowflake):
```sql
SELECT
    s.s_suppkey,
    c.c_custkey,
    ST_DISTANCE(s.supplier_location, c.customer_location) / 1000 as distance_km
FROM supplier_geo s
CROSS JOIN customer_geo c
WHERE c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
LIMIT 1000;
```
